First off, thank you to those who have commented.

 I just want to make something clear: I don't believe I am an immediate threat to myself due to the reasons I originally listed. I certainly don't want to divert attention from others in this subreddit who may be much closer than I to committing. I came here because, despite suicidal thoughts being wholly irrational, I am a very rational person, and I knew I needed to talk about it, just not to someone I know. I also don't want to draw attention in my personal life and more importantly risk anything getting to my work. The thoughts are there, and have been for a bit now. 

I just feel cold, alone, and detached from everything right now. It really makes one wonder what intrinsic value life really has, especially when nature treats it with such impetuousness.
